inventory_boundary.reason: The archived PDF, all figure captions, main text, references, and embedded supplement were read end to end. Source TeX was used only for content enumeration, never as numerical implementation input.

acceptance_criteria: Every declared display item within this implementation's target ids is generated from independently computed Floquet data, never author code, author arrays, digitized curves, or source pixels.
Digest-bound shards cover each predeclared paper condition; aggregation fails closed on missing, stale, or configuration-omitted work.
Trace, level-ratio, endpoint mutual-information, variance, susceptibility, and long-time-spectrum invariants pass for each implemented family.
Unpublished grids, seeds, protocol choices, and the unavailable trapped-ion coupling matrix remain explicitly reconstructed rather than paper-exact.
Potential paper errors require protocol-v2 falsification and fresh-context review, not merely a failed comparison.
The campaign executes from the frozen JSON profile without reading raw/, author code or arrays, reference pixels, or legacy outputs.
Every fixed-denominator item is mapped exactly once to a declared target output or an explicit indispensable-input blocked artifact.
Reduced-scale attestation proves the code path only and does not change scientific coverage or claim paper-scale agreement.
